Open the slides of a lecture

Source: R/lectures.R
slides.Rd

Opens the slides of a lecture in your web browser.

Usage

slides(lecture, course = "statistics", open = interactive())

Arguments

lecture

Number of the lecture, or part of its topic, such as "mixed" or "random forests". A topic must match one lecture only.

course

Which course: "statistics" or "advanced".

open

If TRUE, the default in an interactive session, open the slides in the browser.

Value

The address of the slides, invisibly.

Examples

slides(4, open = FALSE)
slides("random forests in practice", course = "advanced", open = FALSE)
